description: Passively inspects public machine-readable discovery surfaces for a domain. Returns declared and observed evidence, coverage, assurance and a bounded NOMOS read-only admission decision. It does not execute third-party tools, make payments, certify identity or issue compliance verdicts.

domain.description: Bare public domain, e.g. example.com. URLs, IP literals, ports, credentials and local names are rejected.

name: quantum_scan
